question: What is the current MATLAB release?
answer: Based on MATLAB R2026b [1]. R2026b is the current release: MathWorks announced it on September 24, 2026 [1], and the MATLAB Blog says it was released on 23rd September 2026 [2]. The sources don't mention anything newer. Its changes include TOML-based project files, package installation from File Exchange, and Google Sheets integration [1]. MATLAB also no longer includes Java as part of its installation [8].
